restaurant.name: L'AURA
restaurant.address: 428 Heritage Way, Historic Quarter, San Francisco, CA 94108

items.name: Pan-Seared Chilean Sea Bass
items.description: Crisp-skinned Chilean sea bass served over vibrant saffron beurre blanc, flash-fried crispy leeks, heirloom microgreens, and herb oil infusion.

items.name: House Tagliolini al Tartufo
items.description: Silk ribbon tagliolini extruded daily in-house, swirled in cultured Normandy butter, 30-month Parmigiano-Reggiano, and topped with generous shavings of black winter Norcia truffle.

items.name: Roasted Fig & Wild Blackberry Tart
items.description: Butter puff pastry shell layered with roasted mission figs, tart wild mountain blackberries, whipped Madagascar vanilla bean mascarpone, and roasted Sicilian pistachios.

items.name: The Botanical Hour Coupe
items.description: St. George Terroir Gin infused with garden thyme, elderflower liqueur, bergamot cordial, clear carved crystal ice sphere, and edible violas.
items.pairing: Pairs exquisitely with Crudo and Starters

items.name: Pacific Hamachi Crudo
items.description: Sashimi-grade Pacific yellowtail with white yuzu ponzu, fermented chili threads, crisp sea grapes, and cold-pressed olive oil.

items.name: Heirloom Burrata & Charred Peach
items.description: Creamy artisanal pugliese burrata, grilled Brentwood peaches, 12-year Modena balsamic drizzle, torn purple basil, and toasted pine nuts.

items.name: Wild Porcini & Fontina Arancini
items.description: Crispy golden carnaroli rice croquettes stuffed with foraged porcini mushrooms and molten alpine fontina, served with black garlic aioli.

items.name: 45-Day Dry-Aged Prime Ribeye
items.description: 12 oz prime ribeye seared over white oak embers, roasted bone marrow jus, charred cipollini onions, and rosemary-infused sea salt butter.

items.name: Sonoma Duck Breast & Spiced Plum
items.description: Pan-roasted Liberty duck breast with crispy skin, star-anise spiced Italian plum reduction, parsnip purée, and wilted rainbow chard.

items.name: Maine Lobster & Saffron Fettuccine
items.description: Hand-cut egg fettuccine with poached Maine lobster tail chunks, sweet cherry tomatoes, saffron lobster reduction, and tarragon breadcrumbs.

items.name: Agnolotti del Plin di Manzo
items.description: Tiny pinched Piedmontese pasta pillows filled with Barolo-braised short rib, sage brown butter glaze, and aged pecorino shavings.

items.name: Warm Valrhona Dark Chocolate Soufflé
items.description: 70% Guanaja chocolate molten soufflé, baked fresh to order, served tableside with crème anglaise and house-churned crème fraîche gelato.
items.pairing: Taylor Fladgate 20 Year Old Tawny Port

items.name: Meyer Lemon Posset & Thyme Shortbread
items.description: Velvety chilled Meyer lemon cream with lavender berry compote and buttery crumbly sea-salt thyme shortbread cookies.

items.name: Smoked Rosemary Old Fashioned
items.description: WhistlePig 10-Year Rye, charred French oak syrup, Angostura & orange bitters, smoked with flamed garden rosemary under a bell glass.

items.name: Zero-Proof Botanical Garden Spritz
items.description: Distilled Seedlip Spice 94, clarified blood orange juice, sparkling elderflower tonic, rosemary needle garnish, and dehydrated lime wheel.

experiences.title: Main Brasserie Hall
experiences.description: Airy high-ceiling room featuring French oak wainscoting, arched architectural windows, and warm ambient brass lighting. Perfect for celebratory dinners and intimate date nights.

experiences.title: Glasshouse Garden Conservatory
experiences.description: A sun-drenched botanical atrium surrounded by fragrant climbing jasmine, potted citrus trees, and flagstone floors. Idyllic for weekend lunches and sunset dinners.

experiences.title: Chef Eleanor Vance's Counter
experiences.description: An exclusive 8-seat front-row view into the bustling open wood-fired kitchen. Experience our 7-course seasonal tasting menu presented directly by Chef Eleanor Vance.
